recipes.name: Easy Chickpea Tikka Masala
recipes.notes: Don’t leave out sugar, spice with ur heart. Freezes well. Honestly this might be a 5/5 with more veggies it’s so yum

recipes.name: Mediterranean veggies and farro bake
recipes.instructions: Chop 1 red onion, 1 bell pepper, 1 large zucchini, and 1 carrot into equal small pieces. Mince a bunch of garlic. Add all veggies to a baking dish. Cover with basil olive oil, sea salt, black pepper, chili flakes. Bake at 420 for 25 mins. Add in a can of good quality tomatoes, 1/2 can water, miso paste, nutritional yeast, and some farro. Bake for 20 more mins. Top with chopped spinach and a bunch of lemon juice.
recipes.notes:
High ROI. So delicious for how easy this is to make. Great for meal prep. Can easily add a protein. Would add cheese next time and try with pasta or orzo.

Added a star because I make this so often.

recipes.name: Peach corn farro bowl
recipes.instructions: 2 peach, 1/4 onion, grape tomatoes, 1 jalapeño all diced. Cook 1/2 c farro in chicken stock. Season chicken breast with chili oil, cumin, paprika, cayenne, salt and pep. Broil for 15-20 mins. Wrap corn on cob in foil and grill on stove for 10 mins. Add chopped chicken, corn, and chopped dill to salad. Add olive oil, balsamic vinegar, honey, and lemon juice.
recipes.notes: An actual 5 star meal. Don’t need the chicken stock probably.

recipes.name: Beef biryani
recipes.instructions: Slice 1 onion. Sautee in oil until brown (10 mins). Add ginger and garlic paste. Add one can diced tomatoes. Add 1.2 pounds stew meat and 1/4-1/2 packet Shan masala Karachi beef biryani. Add 1/4 c yogurt. Add enough water to cover the beef. Simmer on high for 5 mins and then low for 2.5 hrs. At the 2 hr mark add in one chopped potato and 2 green chilis. When meat and potatoes are tender remove from heat and rest 10 mins. Separately, boil 2c washed basmati rice for 7 mins. Drain rice. Remove masala from pot. Layer rice, masala, rice, masala, rice. Mix food coloring with water and pour in pattern over rice. Add cilantro and chopped butter. Cover with foil, lid, towel, and heavy object. Cook on lowest setting for 25 mins then turn heat off and rest for 10 mins before opening.  Served with yogurt and fried onions
recipes.notes: Sooooooo gooddddd. Rice is perfectly cooked. Used 1/4 packet of masala. Could add more rice next time. Try adding mango achar to meat when simmering. Make with side of raita and veggies. Try using ghee instead of butter. Try using fresh tomatoes (1) instead of canned

recipes.name: Peaches and cream overnight oats
recipes.instructions: Greek yogurt, frozen peaches, vanilla, maple syrup, protein powder, milk blended. Cover dry oats

recipes.name: CTM
recipes.instructions: Cube chicken thighs. Marinate in 1/2 tbsp garam masala, 1/2 tbsp ground cumin, 1/2 tbsp ground coriander, 1 tsp turmeric, 2 tsp salt, hot smoked paprika; 1 cup yogurt, garlic, ginger. Sear chicken in a skillet. Set aside. Add 1/2 diced onion, all the same spices, garlic, ginger, and tomato paste. Add 1 can tomatoes. Blend with some water. Return to pan, add chicken. Add a lot of heavy cream.
recipes.notes: Really good flavor. A little too tomatoey. Make sure the curry is well blended.

recipes.name: Garlic naan
recipes.instructions: Combine 1/4c warm water with 1.5 tsp active dry yeast and 2 tsp white sugar. Add 3/4c warm milk and 3/4c greek yogurt and 1/4 c oil, 2 cloves garlic. Add 1tsp salt and 1 teaspoon baking powder.Add 4c flour. Knead 3-5 mins. Grease bowl, add dough, Cover with Saran Wrap and let rise until 2x size (1 hr). Divide into 10 pieces and roll out. Cook over high heat on a skillet, 1-2 mins each side. Brush with melted butter and garlic. Top with cilantro.
recipes.notes: Soo good

recipes.name: Sikh kababs
recipes.instructions: Blend 1 onion with 1/4 c cilantro, 1 green chili, 1/2 Serrano, 2 tbsp mint, ginger, garlic. Squeeze out moisture. Pat dry ground beef. Add in onion mixture. Add salt, cumin, coriander, salt, red chili flakes, garam masala. Mix with gloved hands. Refrigerate. Form into kababs on skewers. Air fry at 400 for 5 mins each side
recipes.notes: Good spice level. Try adding papaya paste next time.

recipes.name: Chicken chukauni
recipes.instructions: Cube chicken thighs. Marinate in ginger, garlic, salt, pepper, 1sp red chilli powder, 1tsp haldi, 1/2 lemon juiced and sliced onion. Cook the chicken in pan. Mix 1 c Greek yogurt with garlic, pinch ofsalt, and pinch of sugar. Make tadka - heat 1 tbsp oil until smoking. Add mustard seeds and crushed kasoori meethi. Add 1/2 tsp haldi and more red chili powder if needed. Pour over yogurt. Then mix with chicken and fresh cilantro. Eat wth rice
recipes.notes: Try with naan. V good

recipes.name: Fried tofu
recipes.notes: Yummy w good sauce (Mayo, sriracha, sweet chili sauce)

recipes.name: Yellow daal
recipes.notes: Yum. Made without peanuts and couldn’t find mustard seeds. 3 cinnamon sticks and 3 red chiles. Spicyyyy. Cooked the daal in 2 cups water and 3 cups chicken broth. Also the texture wasn’t really right. Try mashing? Should probably add garlic. Added lemon and cilantro.

recipes.name: Miso glazed mahi mahi
recipes.instructions: Defrost fish. Marinate in 1/3 cup each of water, miso paste, rice vinegar (or mirin) plus some sugar for several hours. Pan fry 3 mins each side. Then pour remaining marinade in pan and thicken for a few mins. Serve with sauce on top.
recipes.notes: Real good

recipes.name: Panko crusted air fryer fish
recipes.notes: Crust is really good. Used mahi mahi air fry at 400 degrees for 6 mins each side. Fish was too chewy. I used paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper and could’ve added more seasonings.

recipes.name: Summer salad
recipes.instructions: Arugula salt and pepper and olive oil. Peaches in the air fryer 8 mins at 350. Mozzarella, pecans, balsamic glaze
recipes.notes: P solid. Wanna try with burrata.

recipes.name: Butternut squash pasta
recipes.instructions: Roast butternut squash, half an onion, and two heads of garlic (wrap garlic in foil) with olive oil, salt, pepper, red chili flakes, Italian seasoning at 400 for 30 mins. Blend with pasta water and sour cream. Re season and add nutritional yeast. Add pasta.
recipes.notes: It was like wayyyy better with some Turkey bacon. V good sauce.

recipes.name: Sweet potato carrot ginger soup
recipes.instructions: Poke holes in sweet potatoes, wrap with foil, bake at 350 for like 35? Minutes. Heat olive oil and a little chunk of butter in a pan. Add a shallot, a lot of cloves of garlic, and ginger. Sauté for a bit then add small diced carrots. Add miso paste, salt, pepper, turmeric, cayenne, paprika, fresh thyme, and two bay leaves. Sauté a little. Add half a box of chicken stock. Add lemon juice and nutritional yeast. Cook for a bit. Take out the sweet potatoes when they’re soft and the skin falls off. Cut sweet potatoes and add. Add some heavy cream. Top with unexpected cheddar and black pepper.
recipes.notes:
It’s really quite good. Kinda wish the flavor was a little deeper but it’s quite good. The texture is v interesting.

Added a bunch of zataar instead of thyme and then blended half of it at the end. V good, v spicy, great texture, great flavor ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

recipes.name: Creamy chickpea and hatch Chile stew
recipes.instructions: Olive oil, garlic, hatch chilis, salt, and pepper. Add drained chickpeas, big spoon of tahini, a bunch of stock, paprika, juice of half a lemon, nutritional yeast, and white vinegar. Simmer for a bit. Stir a lot. Keep adding stock as needed. Add in a few big handfuls of spinach. Serve with Parmesan, hatch chilis, and lemon juice and crusty bread.
recipes.notes: It was really almost 5 stars but the texture was kinda weird. Probably should’ve cooked the chickpeas a little longer and added a shallot.

recipes.name: Chickpea pesto tahini salad
recipes.instructions: Chickpeas (drained and mashed), tahini, pesto, fresh basil, cumin, cayenne, honey, lemon juice, nutritional yeast, salt and pepper. Diced onions and radishes
recipes.notes: Literally so good I can just eat it by itself. Add to spinach to make a salad or on bread. Good with pickles

recipes.name: Daal
recipes.instructions: Boil red lentils and potatoes for 10 mins. In a separate pan heat garlic, ginger, green chili, cloves, cinnamon stick, and mustard seeds. Once they bubble add canned tomatoes, cumin, coriander, salt, tumeric, cayenne. Add in lentils once they’re cooked. Add more water if needed.
recipes.notes: “I enjoyed the aromatics and the taters.” - zain

recipes.name: Roasted chickpea and farro salad
recipes.instructions: Roasted chickpeas: rinse and drain chickpeas, dry off, add nutritional yeast, salt, pepper, chili flakes, paprika and roast at 375 for 25 mins. Cook farro in stock, salt, and curry powder. Combine farro, chickpeas, spinach, mini tomatoes and chopped dates with olive oil and lemon juice
recipes.notes: Would be so good with goat cheese. The chickpeas are sooooo good.

recipes.name: Peruvian king oyster mushrooms with aji verde rice
recipes.instructions: Mushrooms: blend miso, Dijon mustard, soy sauce, rice syrup, a clove of garlic, some salt, olive oil, lime zest, and juice if one full lime. Tear up king oyster mushrooms and marinate for 10 ish mins. Fry in oil until crispy.  Aji verde sauce: Mayo, a whole bunch of cilantro (mostly the leaves) roughly chopped jalapeños (some seeds removed), miso, juice of one lime. Fry with cooked rice. Served it all with some roasted corn.
recipes.notes: The sauce is SO good. Overall a bit too oily. Maybe try the mushrooms in the air fryer? They didn’t get crispy enough.

recipes.name: Cauliflower and cheese
recipes.instructions: Roast cauliflower with olive oil at 450 for 20 mins. Heat half a can of coconut cream, add a handful of mozzarella, some cheddar, and some pepper jack. Salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika. Sauce on cauliflower. Top with breadcrumbs. Broil for a bit
recipes.notes: Simple but yum. Great crunch.

recipes.name: Smoked trout spread
recipes.instructions: Diced radishes, dill, everything but the bagel dip, nutritional yeast, salt and pep, smoked trout and some of the oil from the can
recipes.notes: Yummy. Top with balsamic glaze and arugula. Eat fresh

recipes.name: Best pad Thai yet
recipes.instructions: Green onion, half an onion, garlic, brown sugar, tomato paste, red wine vinegar, fish sauce, nutritional yeast, chili flakes, some soy sauce. Heat and mix. Take out. Cook shrimp in pan. Remove. Fry tofu. Add in noodles, sauce, shrimp, some more green onions.
recipes.notes: Tomato paste + vinegar as a sub for tamarind paste!!! Needed an egg and bean sprouts. The sauce is real good. Better with thick noodles

recipes.name: Palak tofu
recipes.instructions: Coat cubed tofu in olive oil, salt, nutritional yeast. Air fry for like 30 mins maybe more. Blanch spinach then blend with a bit of water and a bouillon cube. Fry up 1/2 diced onion with salt, turmeric, cayenne, coriander, and cumin. Add blended spinach. Cook for 10 mins. Serve on top of tofu and rice.
recipes.notes: So shocked by how good this is compared to how easy it is to make and healthy. V yummy. A repeat winner.

recipes.name: Channa masala
recipes.instructions: Heat oil. Add whole cinnamon, three cloves, bay leaf. Once apices start to sizzle add chopped onion and stir until slightly brown. Add garlic. Add turmeric, red chili powder, coriander, and some paprika. Add chopped tomatoes. Salt and pepper. Cook until tomatoes soften. Add can of chickpeas. Cover and cook. Add water as needed. Taste and adjust. Finish a little bit of honey.
recipes.notes: The whole spices make this soooo good. Missing ginger, cumin, and lemon juice. Also could’ve added tomato paste. Served with rice and Greek yogurt

recipes.name: Harira (Moroccan soup)
recipes.instructions: Blend quartered onion with a can of tomatoes. Toast ginger, cinnamon, cumin, and turmeric in olive oil. Add tomatoes and onion. Add full can chickpeas and one cup red lentils. Add salt and water. Add pinch saffron. Cook until lentils are soft. Add more water and tomato paste as needed.
recipes.notes: Served with hot sauce and a teaspoon of labneh. The labneh really took it to another level. Add cilantro next time. Good for meal prep.

recipes.name: Tomato cream seafood papardelle
recipes.instructions: Butter, garlic cloves, canned tomatoes, salt, pepp, Italian seasoning, paprika, red pepper flakes, heavy cream. Simmer for a bit. Add in mixed seafood, pasta water. Add al dente papardelle.
recipes.notes: Soooooooo good.

recipes.name: The best banana bread overnight oats
recipes.instructions: Mashed banana, oats, chia seeds, splash of oat brown sugar creamer, almond milk, cinnamon, dash of vanilla extract
recipes.notes: Slapssssss

recipes.name: Shredded tofu stir fry
recipes.instructions: Freeze and defrost tofu. Squeeze out extra water. Sautee two garlic cloves, two Thai red chilis, and lots of green onions in olive oil. Add in shredded tofu, salt and pep, sesame oil, rice vinegar, some general tso’s sauce, soy sauce, and some honey.
recipes.notes: Really good. Would be great with some sesame seeds, stir fry veg, and white rice.

recipes.name: Easy!!! Banana chocolate chip bagels
recipes.instructions: 1 mashed ripe banana, mix with 1 c greek yogurt, 1 egg, honey, vanilla extract. In a separate bowl mix 1.5 c flour, 2 tsp baking powder, salt, cinnamon. Add wet to dry plus some chocolate chips. Add more flour if needed. On a floured board, roll into logs and connect the ends. Top with more choc chips. Bake at 375 on a lined baking sheet for 17-20 mins.
recipes.notes: Made 6 bagels. I realize now that the egg was supposed to be for an egg wash, not in the batter. Try egg wash next time instead of putting in the batter. Messy but worth it. The bagels are chewy and so yummy. Need to make them thicker if I want to add toppings next time but they are good plain.

recipes.name: Chicken satay ish
recipes.instructions: Chicken: Cut chicken into 1 in strips. Marinate in PB, soy sauce, fish sauce, rice vinegar, garlic, ginger, green onions, and sesame oil. Bake at 425 for 10 mins. Rice: Cook rice in chicken bone broth. Once cooked top with a little drizzle of ghee. Cucumber salad: mix chopped cucumber with mint, green onions, rice vinegar, salt, pep, sesame seeds, and chili crunch
recipes.notes: Yum yum yum. Chicken isn’t dry but would be better with thighs

recipes.name: Keema aloo
recipes.instructions: Sauté diced onion in ghee. Once it’s soft add garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, turmeric, red chili powder. Once fragrant add ground beef and salt. Once oil separates, add can of tomatoes. Once cooked down add diced potato.
recipes.notes: Soooo good. Would be better with green chili. Try adding peas next time.

recipes.name: Japanese sweet potatoes with Miso lime butter
recipes.instructions: Mix butter with miso paste, lime zest, lime juice, sesame seeds. Bake Japanese sweet potatoes at 400 for 60 mins.
recipes.notes: The miso butter is kinda life changing

recipes.name: Chicken tikka bites
recipes.instructions: Cut chicken thighs into cubes. Marinade is 3 tablespoons yogurt, one tablespoon oil, paprika, red chili powder, cumin, coriander, haldi, salt, pepper. Air fry at 400 for 15 mins with some sliced onions. Serve with naan
recipes.notes: Soooo good and easy. Could add orange food coloring

recipes.name: Roasted broccoli and chickpea Caesar salad
recipes.instructions: Roast broccoli and rinsed chickpeas in olive oil and spices at 425 for 25 mins. Toast breadcrumbs in olive oil in a pan. Mix veggies with shredded parm, breadcrumbs, and Caesar dressing.
recipes.notes: Simple yummy and filling. Go easy on salt

recipes.name: Szechuan PB chicken thighs
recipes.instructions: Cut chicken thighs into 1 inch strips. Mix homemade pb, soy sauce, rice vinegar, grated clove of garlic, rice vinegar, lime juice, Szechuan hot sauce. Marinate chicken for 30 mins. Air fry at 400 for 10 mins.
recipes.notes: Omg sooooo good. Nutty, spicy, sour. Chicken is juicy.

recipes.name: steak
recipes.instructions: Pat dry steaks. Salt and pepper on both sides. Heat skillet w oil. Sear steaks for 2 mins on high on each side. Lower heat to low, add butter and garlic cloves. Baste steaks for one min. Let rest for 10 mins before cutting against the grain.
recipes.notes: Ate these in a salad, tacos, and sandwiches. P good.

recipes.name: creamy curry ramen with crispy ground beef
recipes.instructions: Blanche halved bok choy and set aside. Heat oil in a skillet. Add 1/2 lb ground beef, s and p, cumin, coriander, turmeric, cayenne, some soy sauce. Let the beef get crispy then remove and set aside. Add whits of green onions, garlic, ginger. Add tomato paste and red curry paste. Add all the same spices and let them bloom. Add one can coconut milk and mix well. Seperarely, cook fresh ramen noodles. Once cooked, combine everything. Top with lime and greens of onions.
recipes.notes: Vvvv good. Less oil next time and more bok choy

recipes.name: Salmon feta pasta
recipes.instructions: Bake salmon filets, one tub of crumbled feta, cherry tomatoes, and a bunch of spinach with vegan pesto, garlic, Calabrian chilis, salt, and pepper at 400 for 15 mins. Cook egg noodles. Mix noodles and pasta water with baked fish.
recipes.notes: Use smaller tomatoes if possible so they get gooey. Could’ve done a block of feta instead of crumbled feta. Full bag of spinach instead of half

recipes.name: Garam masala
recipes.instructions: Toast 1tbsp cumin seeds, 1 tbsp black peppercorns, 3/4 tbsp whole cloves, 15 green cardamom pods, 2 bay leaves. Grind with 1 tbsp ground coriander, and cinnamon.
recipes.notes: Fresh whole spices make such a difference. Maybe less cloves and add star anise next time

recipes.name: Carne asada
recipes.instructions: One orange + 2 key likes juiced, soy sauce, avocado oil, 2 tbsp carne asada seasoning. Marinate then sear on high heat for 4-6 mins each side
recipes.notes: V good. Could use cilantro

recipes.name: Doner kabab
recipes.instructions: Blend 1/2 onion and 2 garlic cloves. Mix by hand with ground beef, 1/4 c yogurt, paprika, cumin, salt and pepper. Spread in a thin layer in between two pieces of parchment paper. Roll one piece of parchment paper plus beef into 2” rolls. Bake on a tray with tomato and onion at 400 for 15 mins. Drain liquid and unwrap beef. Broil for 5 mins.
recipes.notes: Served on lavash with hummus, zaatar, fatoosh, fries, and garlic yogurt sauce. Could use a little more heat and pickles.

recipes.name: Perfectly crispy chicken thighs
recipes.notes: Kinda meh. Cooking method was great but chicken was kinda bland. Maybe if it was marinated for awhile? Looked pretty and super easy

recipes.name: Chickpea and zucchini kofta
recipes.notes: Pretty good, might’ve been better if I had coriander and garam masala. Texture of koftas was good. Put zucchini and chickpeas in nutri bullet instead of mashing

recipes.name: Pad Thai ish
recipes.instructions: Freeze tofu then defrost in fridge. Marinate in sauce for 10 mins. For sauce mix tamarind sauce, soy sauce, ginger, sriracha, peanut butter, rice vinegar and a little water. Stir fry carrots, broccoli, edamame with salt and Chile lime seasoning. Add tofu and sauce and stir fry until tofu is brown. Add steamed rice noodles. Add an egg. Top with lemon and peanuts.
recipes.notes: Almost a 4 stars but maybe marinate the tofu overnight? Add fish sauce? Add shrimp?

recipes.name: Kung pao Brussels sprouts
recipes.notes: Like I don’t even like Brussels sprouts and I didn’t want to like these but they’re honestly really good. For the sauce I used sriracha, soy sauce, corn starch, ginger, garlic, rice vinegar, and some leftover teriyaki sauce. Also they lasted in the fridge forever and they’re super filling. It would be 4 stars if I liked Brussels sprouts

recipes.name: Garlicky bok Choy
recipes.notes: Good

recipes.name: Soy chorizo fajitas in a bowl
recipes.instructions:
Mexican rice: tomato paste, nutritional yeast, diced onion and garlic. Should have used chicken stock

Soy chorizo + fajita veggies: sauté garlic, sliced onion, bell pepper with salt, cumin, paprika, and chili lime seasoning. Add soy chorizo and brown. Turn off the heat and top with shredded cheese.

Canned beans add garlic powder and a bunch of Serrano pepper sauce and a little bit of water.

Top with pickled carrots, hot sauce, and green salsa
recipes.notes: This feels like an elevated hug in a bowl. Three bc the flavors are friends but they’re not married. I think if the rice had stock it would all come together a little better. But it does still feel like a hug.

recipes.name: Good salad for tempura shrimp
recipes.instructions: Spinach with cabbage. Edamame, baby corn, sautéed asparagus, sliced radishes, chopped blood orange. Top with peanut dressing.

recipes.name: Gojuchang Tofu
recipes.notes: Used frozen and then thawed tofu. No sugar or ketchup. Added tomato paste, hot honey, and some sweet pickle juice. Texture of the tofu is chewy but not crispy. It’s pretty good.

recipes.name: Gochujang shrimp curry
recipes.instructions: Sauté onion and garlic. Add gochujang, coconut milk, curry powder, salt and pepper, and water. Simmer until it thickens a lil. Season shrimp and add. Cook until it looks good.
recipes.notes: Yummy but it could be thicker and could use more veggies

recipes.name: Braised kale
recipes.instructions: NYT cooking: sauté garlic and onion. Add tomato paste and season with a ton of smoked paprika. Darken it a little, then add a good amount of stock, vinegar, and chopped kale. Cover and cook until the kale is soft and liquid is reduced. Season with salt and red chili flakes
recipes.notes: I don’t even like kale but it’s yummy.

recipes.name: Spring roll bowl
recipes.instructions: Rice noodles, one cucumber, broccoli slaw (shredded broccoli, carrots, cabbage) mango, jalapeños, one green onion, peanuts. Dressing is peanut butter, chili oil, ginger, rice vinegar, soy sauce, lime juice, brown sugar.  Mix the noods with dressing. Add veggies then add more dressing
recipes.notes: Liked it more than I thought I would. Would be better with tofu.

recipes.name: Gooseberry salad
recipes.instructions: Spinach, gooseberries, basil, mint, walnuts, unexpected cheddar, farro cooked in stock. Olive oil, lemon juice, white vinegar, salt and pepper
recipes.notes: Everything gets better after sitting in the olive oil for a bit. The unexpected cheddar is a really good choice

recipes.name: Garlicky white beans with tinned fish
recipes.instructions: Sliced garlic, lemon zest, lemon juice, dill, green hot sauce and rinse and drained white beans. Top with tinned smoked mackerel
recipes.notes: Better than I expected. I put the juice of a whole lemon plus zest. Served with toasted sourdough with butter

recipes.name: Canned salmon salad
recipes.instructions: Cabbage slaw, edamame, cucumber, and a seeded and diced jalapeño. Dressing is pb, chili oil, rice vinegar, rice syrup, diced ginger, soy sauce, and a lil bit of lemon juice. Mix veggies with dressing, top with half a can of wild caught salmon, dried seaweed, and peanuts
recipes.notes: Ratio of easy to yummy is v good. Would give it a 3.5

recipes.name: Smoked trout salad
recipes.instructions: Arugula, sliced radishes, curry farro, chopped dates, smoked trout, walnuts. Dressing is basil olive oil, red wine vinegar, salt and pep, garlic powder
recipes.notes: Needs lemon juice and maybe cherry tomatoes

recipes.name: Whole lemon zucchini beans
recipes.instructions: Heat up lots of olive oil. Add sliced full lemon and sliced zucchini and salt. Cook for about 7 mins, then add in lots of garlic, chili flakes, oregano, and nutritional yeast. Cook until zucchini and lemon are soft. Add a full can of white beans. Add water, salt, chili flakes as needed. Add in grated cheese.
recipes.notes: Conceptually I like this but realistically the whole lemon is a bit too much. Next time try cooking the lemon down for longer. Would be better w fresh basil and maybe more salt.

recipes.name: Warm citrus farro salad
recipes.instructions: Sautee sliced onion and garlic. Add chopped asparagus. Season with salt and pep. Once asparagus is done set aside. Cook farro with salt, pep. Nutritional yeast, and a bay leaf. Once farro is finished stir in asparagus, onions, lemon infused olive oil, lots of chili flakes, spinach, and a diced orange.
recipes.notes: Topped with salmon. Pretty good. Next time cook farro in broth

recipes.name: Mayak eggs
recipes.instructions: Boil eggs for 6-7 mins. Make marinade with soy sauce, dark soy sauce, honey, sesame seeds, scallions, garlic powder, and diced red pepper. Put boiled eggs in ice bath then peel and marinate overnight.
recipes.notes: Serve cold with warm rice. Good ROI. Needs more honey, tastes too salty

recipes.name: Cauliflower mini pizzas
recipes.instructions: Cauliflower thins, pesto, shredded chicken meatballs, mozzarella cheese. Bake for a bit and then broil for a bit.
recipes.notes: Simple and yummy. Would be good with mushrooms.

recipes.name: Date caramel
recipes.instructions: Soak 10 dates in hot water. Blend with 1/4 c coconut cream, salt, and cinnamon.
recipes.notes: Good sweetener

recipes.name: Chickpea cake
recipes.instructions: Blend 2 eggs, 3 tablespoons coconut oil, vanilla, 1/4ish c sweetner (rice syrup and/or dare caramel), 1/4 c flour, 1/4 c oats, 1 can rinsed and drained chickpeas, salt, 1/2 teaspoon baking soda, 1/2 teaspoon baking powder. Pour into 8x8 pan, add choc chips on top, and bake at 350 for 28 mins.
recipes.notes: Solid for a healthy sweet treat. Made with one egg and avocado oil instead of coconut also blend extra long and it was best ever

recipes.name: Crispy orange tofu
recipes.instructions: Toss torn tofu with nutritional yeast, salt, pep, and some flour. Bake at 400 for 30-35 mins, flipping once. While thats baking combine fresh orange juice (from two oranges), orange zest, dark soy sauce, water, garlic, and ginger. Simmer to thicken. Add a little bit of flour mixed with water to thicken (may need to whisk in to sauce). Once gooey, remove from heat and stir in  some honey. toss with crispy tofu once finished. Top with sesame seeds.
recipes.notes: This could be really good. I put too much flour to thicken I think. Also could’ve let the tofu get even crispier in the oven. Would be better with brown sugar instead of honey I think. Served with steamed broccoli and kimchi. Probably shouldve included rice.

recipes.name: Calabrian chili chicken lettuce cups
recipes.instructions: Mix a spoon of Callabrian chili paste with 1/2 c ish greek yogurt and shredded roast chicken. That’s it. Stuff in butter lettuce wraps.
recipes.notes: So simple, so healthy, so yummy. Try adding in diced cucumber or celery I think. Also good served with crackers.

recipes.name: Chicken sausage, asparagus, peas, gnocchi
recipes.instructions: Boil gnocchi. Sautee asparagus, chicken sausage, and frozen peas in olive oil. Add salt, pepper, oregano, and garlic powder. Add cooked gnocchi.
recipes.notes: Better than expected. Quick and easy to make.

recipes.name: Salmon with radishes
recipes.instructions: Pickle radishes. Blend radish tops with salt and pep, Mayo, lemon juice, garlic oil. Broil salmon for 9 mins, top with sauce
recipes.notes: Super hard to blend but overall good

recipes.name: Crispy shrimp rice paper rolls
recipes.instructions: Dice shrimp. Mix with some ginger, green onions, salt and pepp. Wet rice paper and place filling in the bottom. Fold bottom up, sides in, and roll. Fry in oil for like 2 mins on each side.
recipes.notes: Good but could use some more flavor

recipes.name: Garlic lemon chicken thighs
recipes.instructions: Marinate chicken thighs in two cloves garlic, salt, pep, red pep, oregano, olive oil, lemon zest, lemon juice. Put in baking sheet with sliced lemon. Bake at 400 for 40 mins and then broil for 5 mins.
recipes.notes: Doesn’t reheat that well so not great for meal prep but tastes good

recipes.name: Smoked trout pasta salad
recipes.instructions: TJs lemon pasta. Mix canned smoked trout with some of the oil from the can, yogurt, nutritional yeast, EBB seasoning, pickled radishes, chopped dill, chopped cucumbers.
recipes.notes: Yummmmmmmmmmm

recipes.name: Saffron corn pasta with smoked mussels and Calabrian chili breadcrumbs
recipes.instructions: Sauté chopped onion and garlic in butter. Add fresh corn. Put saffron on an ice cube. Add saffron and salt. Cook pasta. Once corn is soft blend corn mixture with a bit of pasta water, miso paste, and butter. Add sauce to pasta. Toast panko breadcrumbs in Calabrian chili paste and oil. Add smoked mussels to pasta. Top with breadcrumbs.
recipes.notes: This would be 5 stars as a dinner but I didn’t really want to eat it again as leftovers. The mussels get too much for multiple meals. Would make again for fancy din.

recipes.name: Turkey meatball Thai curry
recipes.instructions: Mix 1.5 lbs ground Turkey with curry powder, salt, pep, one egg, 1/2 c panko breadcrumbs, garlic, ginger. Shape into 15-20 meatballs. Brown meatballs in butter. Once they’re brown add onions and cook. Add green curry paste and salt. Add frozen veggies. Add one can coconut milk, dark soy sauce, and fish sauce. Cook until thickened.
recipes.notes: Pretty solid, simple

recipes.name: Lasagna soup
recipes.instructions: Sautee chopped onion and garlic. Add ground beef and cook until browned. Add one jar pasta sauce, one box chicken stock, oregano, Italian seasoning, and bay leaves. Bring to a boil. Add broken up lasagna noodles and one cup heavy cream. Boil for 10 mins. Top with shredded mozzarella.
recipes.notes: Yummy and comfy. Not very healthy.

recipes.name: Carmelized onion pasta
recipes.instructions: Sliced onions with paprika, oregano, sun dried tomatoes + oil, one full head garlic. Cover with foil and bake for one hour. Add lemon juice and some cream. Add cooked pasta and some pasta water. Serve with chicken sausage
recipes.notes: Pretty simple and easy. Would be better with spinach

recipes.name: Sheet pan beef kofta
recipes.instructions: Grate onion. Squeeze out juice. Mix onion with 1 lb ground veal, garlic paste, olive oil, coriander, cumin, salt, pepper, sumac, oregano, paprika, and cayenne. Line a sheet pan with parchment paper. Create a thin rectangle of meat. Separate into strips with the back of a knife. Add salted quartered tomatoes. Drizzle with olive oil. Bake at 400 for 25mins. Broil for 5 mins.
recipes.notes: Served with hummus and pita bread. Pretty good and quick.

recipes.name: Beef bulgogi
recipes.instructions: Freeze steak for 20mins. Blend 1/2 pear, gochujang, garlic, ginger, 1/4 c soy sauce, sesame oil. Slice onion. Thin slice beef against the grain. Combine with onions and marinate
recipes.notes: Slices were not thin enough

recipes.name: Chicken congee
recipes.instructions: Rinse 3/4 c Jasmine rice. Boil in 3 c stock + 4 c water. Reduce to simmer and add whole chicken breast. Add whole ginger and garlic. Simmer for 40 mins. Remove chicken breast and shred and then add back. Add fish sauce, soy sauce, sambal olek, salt, and pepper, sesame oil.

recipes.name: Herby chicken meatballs
recipes.instructions: 1 lb ground chicken, 1/2 small diced onion, 1 egg, 1/4 c breadcrumbs soaked, minced garlic + 1/2 jalapeños, chopped dill, parsley, and mint, salt, pepper, cumin, coriander, Calabrian chilis. Combine and then bake at 400 for 20 mins. Flip and broil for 5 mins.
recipes.notes: Breadcrumbs keep it juicy. Very versatile.

recipes.name: Braised chicken thighs
recipes.instructions: 2 lb chicken thighs, pat dry and season with s and p. Sear in olive oil. Remove from pan, add diced onion and garlic. Once fragrant add tomato paste, oregano, paprika and cook until color changes. Add 24 oz good quality chicken broth and bring to simmer. Once simmering, transfer to oven and bake at 325 for 20 mins. Remove from oven, add 2 big handfuls of spinach + lemon juice and cover. Serve with baguette
recipes.notes: Easy, healthy, good. Good quality chicken broth is important. Maybe add Calabrian chili?

recipes.name: Brioche buns
recipes.instructions:
1 cup warm water, about 75–85 F
3 tablespoons warm milk (I prefer whole milk)
2 teaspoons active dry yeast
2 1/2 tablespoons granulated sugar
1 large egg
3 1/3 cup all-purpose flour 
1 1/2 teaspoons fine sea salt
2 1/2 tablespoons unsalted butter, softened 
Bloom yeast and seperatelt beat egg. .Combine dry ingredients and butter with fingertips. Add wet ingredients and knead 5 mins. Cover and rise until doubled (1 hr). Line baking sheet with parchment paper. Shape into balls, flatten, and then pinch in the sides to make buns. Cover and rise about an hour until puffy. Brush with milk. Place a pan with 1/2 c water on the oven floor. Bake at 400 for 15-20 mins. Cool on a wire rack.

recipes.name: Japanese steamed egg custard
recipes.instructions: gently beat 3 eggs. add 1 c cooled miso soup. place raw shrimp (2-3) in ramekin. strain egg mixture into ramekin. boil water for steamer. once boiling reduce to medium. cover ramekin loosely with foil and steam 8 mins. top with green onion and sesame oil
recipes.notes: so good and simple

recipes.name: Healthier cookie dough
recipes.instructions: 2 c oats ground. 1/3 c maple syrup, 1/4 c pb, salt, vanilla extract, about 1/2 c milk. Mix everything and fold in chocolate chips
recipes.notes: Tastes good after refrigerating for a few hrs

recipes.name: Korean Carrot Salad
recipes.instructions: Peel and then shave carrots into ribbons. Add rice vinegar. Heat avocado oil. Add garlic powder, paprika, cayenne pepper, salt and pepper.
recipes.notes: It literally tastes like potato chips after marinating for 2 days.

recipes.name: Sweet potato brownie
recipes.instructions: Poke holes in sweet potato and microwave for 5 mins. Flip and microwave another few minutes. Once sweet potato is cooled mash (should be about 2/3 c). Add some maple syrup, about 2 tablespoons pb, about 2 tablespoons avocado oil. Mix wet ingredients. Add 2/3 c oat flour, 1/3 c ap flour, salt, 1 tsp baking powder. Dough should be wet and spreadable. Add 1/2 c milk if needed. Fold in choc chips. Bake at 350 for 25 mins.
recipes.notes: Brownies texture. V yummy.

recipes.name: White chicken korma
recipes.instructions: Stir fry 1.5 onions until golden brown. Set aside. To the same pan add garlic and then cubed chicken. Blend the onions with 1 c Greek yogurt and 2 green chilis. Add sauce to chicken plus 1 c ish of water. Add garam masala, ginger powder, coriander, cumin, haldi, salt, black pepper, little bit of red chili powder. Taste. Simmer for 15 mins
recipes.notes: Really good and quite simple. I left out the heavy cream added at the end. Also would be better with ginger garlic paste

recipes.name: Sweet potato mochi
recipes.instructions: Peel and rough chop one medium sweet potato. Steam until tender (20 mins). Transfer to bowl and mash with 2 tbsp white sugar. Add 1 c glutinous rice flour. Knead until smooth. Roll and shape into twinkies (10-12). Heat oil in a wok. Deep fry. Keep flipping and press down as mochis inflate to make them poofy. Drain in a colander over a mixing bowl. Serve warm
recipes.notes: 10/10 honestly

recipes.name: Flour tortillas
recipes.instructions: 2 c AP flour, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp baking powder. Mix. Add 1/4 c softened butter and mix with fingertips. Add 2/3 c warm water, mixing as you add. Knead 5 mins then divide into 8 balls and cover with damp towel for 15 mins. Roll out and fry in a hot fry skillet. Should puff up in 15 seconds per side. Cover cooked tortilla with damp towel so the steam softens tortilla
recipes.notes: Much better than store bought

recipes.name: Healthier plum cake
recipes.instructions:
For the plums
6 black or red plums, thinly sliced
2 tbsp butter
2 tbsp brown sugar
2 tbsp milk (whole or 2%)
½ tsp cardamom
For the cake
1½ cups all-purpose flour
¼ cup oat flour (or whole-wheat flour)
½ tsp baking powder
½ tsp baking soda
½ tsp salt
1 tsp ground ginger
1 tsp cinnamon
½ tsp ground cardamom
1/3 c  sugar (brown and cane)
Zest of ½ lemon
2 eggs
1 tsp vanilla
½ cup Greek yogurt
⅓ cup olive oil
1/2 cup milk
Plum compote
7-8 plums, chopped
Juice of ½ lemon
1 tbsp brown sugar (or skip it if your plums are very ripe)
How I'd make it
Heat oven to 350°F. Line your cake pan with parchment and lightly oil it.
Make the plum topping:
Gently heat the butter, brown sugar, milk and cardamom in a small saucepan until the sugar dissolves. Don't boil it.
Arrange your sliced plums tightly in the bottom of the pan, starting around the outside and working inward. Pour the butter mixture over them.
Make the dry ingredients: whisk together flour, oat flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, ginger, cinnamon and cardamom.
In another bowl, combine the cane sugar, brown sugar and lemon zest. Rub the zest into the sugar with your fingers—definitely keep this step because it makes the cake taste much more fragrant without adding anything extra.
Whisk in the eggs, vanilla, Greek yogurt, olive oil and milk.
Fold the dry ingredients into the wet mixture just until combined. Don't overmix.
Spoon the batter over the plums and gently smooth the top.
Bake 35–40 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Let it cool for about 15–20 minutes, then carefully invert onto a plate and peel off the parchment.
For the compote, simmer the chopped plums, lemon juice and 1 tbsp brown sugar over medium-low heat until soft and jammy.
,
recipes.notes: Breakfast or dessert. The plum and spices are the stars. Plum compote took a while to cook down.
